ops.parking: Self-parking is in the OTEMACHI ONE underground car park (open 7:00-23:00); the maximum vehicle size is 5.3 m long, 2.0 m wide and 1.5 m high. The fee is 400 yen per 30 minutes, and 100 yen per hour outside operating hours. For hotel guests, 5,000 yen per night per car (24 hours). Valet parking is 6,500 yen for hotel guests and 1,500 yen for restaurant guests (self-parking fee is charged separately). The entrance and exit are on the north side of the building.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has PIGNETO (Italian; one private room and a rooftop terrace), est (contemporary French; three semi-private rooms and a rooftop terrace), THE LOUNGE, and VIRTÙ (bar; the private lounge is introduced as a venue for welcome cocktails). The rooftop terraces of est and PIGNETO are available for private-hire parties.
